result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content (category chips and restaurant cards) is clipped at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and the top-right notification/profile button appears as an empty gray circle with only a small red dot, lacking an icon or label.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards and the category filter chips are cut off at the right screen edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll indicator or gradient hint that more content exists horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient or scroll indicator, and ensure card widths/spacing make it obvious the row is horizontally scrollable. Also use text ellipsis with adequate truncation for long restaurant names.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner renders as an empty light-gray circle containing only a tiny red notification dot; no icon (e.g. profile, bell, or avatar) is visible, making its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable icon or user avatar inside the circle so users understand it is a profile/notifications button, and keep the red dot as a badge overlay.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the top-right button has no accompanying label or badge count, and the button itself lacks a visible text label, which can be confusing for screen-reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessibility label (e.g. 'Profile, 1 notification') and consider a count badge instead of an unlabeled dot.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word at the card edge, which looks awkward combined with the clipped card.
issues.suggestion: Reserve enough card width or apply a clean ellipsis so truncated names end gracefully rather than being cut by the viewport edge.
